# ktor-svelte 0.11.0

> Ship a Ktor API and a SvelteKit frontend as one app: one JAR, one port, and a TypeScript client that matches your routes.

The whole documentation as one Markdown file: https://nijasc.github.io/ktor-svelte/v0.11.0/llms-full.txt
